PocketGigaScan Windows packages include unmodified Microsoft Visual C++ runtime
files copied from the x64 Release directory of the selected Visual Studio 2026
installation's VC/Redist/MSVC toolset. The package build verifies that the
runtime directory is the x64 Microsoft.VC*.CRT release directory and checks
that every included DLL is a valid x64 PE image. Debug runtime files are not
included.

Microsoft permits app-local redistribution of applicable Visual C++ runtime
files subject to the Visual Studio license terms. Consult the current official
redistribution terms before copying or modifying these files:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2026/redistribution

Microsoft's deployment guidance:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/choosing-a-deployment-method?view=msvc-170
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/determining-which-dlls-to-redistribute?view=msvc-170

The runtime DLLs remain Microsoft's copyrighted materials and are distributed
without modification. This notice is informational and does not replace or
expand Microsoft's license terms.
